definitions.title: First and Second Derivatives of Parametric Curves
definitions.statement: The tangent slope dy/dx is the ratio of vertical to horizontal velocity. The second derivative d^2y/dx^2 measures concavity by differentiating dy/dx with respect to t and dividing again by dx/dt.
definitions.explanation: Critical pitfall: d^2y/dx^2 is NOT equal to (d^2y/dt^2)/(d^2x/dt^2).
definitions.keyTakeaway: Always divide by dx/dt when computing derivatives with respect to x.

definitions.title: Arc Length of a Parametric Curve
definitions.statement: The arc length of a smooth parametric curve from t = a to t = b is the integral of particle speed |v(t)| = sqrt((x')^2 + (y')^2).
conditions: Curve is traversed exactly once without backtracking
definitions.explanation: Integrates infinitesimal distance ds = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2).
definitions.keyTakeaway: Arc length integrates speed over time.
